definition: deviating from what is normal or expected
example: The aberrant behavior of the student concerned the teacher.
The project was held in abeyance until funding could be secured.
The thief absconded with the stolen jewels before anyone noticed.

definition: moderate in appetite; sparing in use of food or drink
example: Her abstemious lifestyle helped her maintain excellent health.

definition: to caution or advise against something; to scold mildly
example: The teacher admonished the students for talking during the exam.

definition: dealing with or capable of appreciation of the beautiful
example: The museum's aesthetic appeal attracted art lovers from around the world.

definition: to gather into a mass, sum, or whole
example: The company will aggregate data from multiple sources.
She accepted the invitation with alacrity.

definition: to make easier to endure; lessen; mitigate
example: The medication helped alleviate her pain.

definition: to combine into a unified whole; to mix, merge
example: The two companies decided to amalgamate their operations.
